Proposition
[Linear maximal-regularity estimate (Proposition 35.18)] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0311 1. ch35:35.18\group Maximal Regularity

If $f\in C([0,T];\mathcal E_\theta )$ and the spectral bound $\omega =\sup \{ \operatorname {Re}\lambda :\lambda \in \sigma (A)\} <0$, then for $\eta +\omega <0$, \begin{equation*} \sup _t\| e^{\eta t}u’(t)\| _{\mathcal E_\theta } +\sup _t\| e^{\eta t}u(t)\| _{\mathcal E_{1+\theta }} \le C\sup _t\| e^{\eta t}f(t)\| _{\mathcal E_\theta }. \tag {35.12} \end{equation*}
